_comment: Frame for the worked example. Fictional throughout.

outcome.answer: I want the board to approve closing three depots and release a $2.6M transition budget at the October meeting.

audience.answer: The CEO and CFO decide. Two non-executive directors will push back on service risk. None of them are operators.

kind_and_size.answer: A findings-and-recommendation deck, about 12 slides, sent ahead and then presented.

q1_outcome.answer: The board approves the consolidation of Ridgeway, Brookline and Oakmont and releases the $2.6M transition budget by Oct 15.

q2_message.answer: Consolidating three depots saves $4.1M a year for a one-time cost of $2.6M, with next-day coverage held for 99.2% of customers.

q3_situation.situation: Halvard runs nine depots; the network was sized before the Carver contract ended and before Easton expanded.
q3_situation.complication: Three depots have run below 40% utilisation for six quarters, and the Oakmont lease renews in March at a 12% step-up.

q4_audience.what_they_believe: That the network is roughly the right size and closures are a service risk
q4_audience.pushback: Loss of next-day service; union delay at Ridgeway

q8_genre.evidence: sources are an operating model and interview notes, not a proposal

must_include: the 17 customers who lose next-day service
must_match: the $2.6M figure already quoted to the CFO
